title: net1 v6 candidates with a copies belief, and round 14's best stage 2 checkpoints, on every validation family
description: PPO on net1 v6 clears both competition conditions but loses 0.26 to 0.30 as copies (exp-net2-eval-v6-159, exp-net2-eval-v6-ens-160). This evaluates seven candidates on net1 v6 (release model-net2-v6-veto): round 7e's recipe on v6 (round 18's gate3 DAgger students, three seeds as one policy on their mean beliefs, teacher gain 0.5 and 1); round 15's copies-arm PPO policies, seeds 1 to 3, with their push vetoed by round 18's mean copies belief, u = u_rule + (1 - q) (u_PPO - u_rule); and round 14 stage 2's tau 5 s cells at iteration 39, their best validation checkpoints. All run next to the fixed rule on net1 v6 (u = 0.25), the share rule (k = 0.5 and 1) and BBRv3 on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s, campaign seed 21; experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py scores them against rule-v6. It chooses what goes to the gate, which runs on a fresh campaign seed: these candidates were picked on these validation links.
prepare: (cd "$IN/c" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); N="$IN/v6/net1-v6-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule6" "$N" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$N" --u0 0.25 --k 0.5 1; P=(--policy "rule-v6=$OUT/rule6/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "share-k0.5=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k0.5.onnx" --policy "share-k1=$OUT/share/share-u0.25-k1.onnx"); for f in "$IN"/c/ppo-*.onnx; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$f" .onnx)=$f"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && mv "$OUT/summary.md" "$OUT/against-bbr3.md" && uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py "$OUT" rule-v6
